Introduction

Jung Ye In is a South Korean singer under Sublime Artist Agency. She is best known as thr lead dancer, main vocalist, and maknae of the girl group Lovelyz. Formed by Woollim Entertainment, Lovelyz debuted on November 17, 2014 with the album "Girls' Invasion".

She made her solo debut with "Plus n Minus" on January 25, 2022.
